findings.title: Chat launcher covers reader text on mobile
findings.observed: At 390x844 the collapsed chat iframe occupies an 86x86 area at the bottom right and covers article paragraph line endings. The same overlap appears on case-study, archive, and writing-list pages. A native browser repro confirmed the iframe rectangle x=304,y=758,width=86,height=86 intersects a paragraph at x=24,y=676,width=342,height=168.
findings.expected: The collapsed chat control remains reachable without covering reading text or page controls on mobile.
repro: Wait for the green chat launcher to load; switch to dark theme if needed to match the screenshot.
Read the introductory paragraph near the bottom of the viewport. The launcher covers the right-hand line endings; scrolling moves different reading text underneath it.
